Audit deployment environment/config precedence for CHAT_MAX_ROOMS across all instances, restore 5,120 (and the documented note cap), and expose/log effective limits at startup; the ~10 MiB top-room files suggest per-room compaction is functioning, so quota enforcement—not rotation—is the actionable fault.
auditor_verdict: AGREE overall: capacities stepped 20,480→40,960→81,920→163,840, while occupancy reached 50,657—9.9× 5,120—and remained 46,522, so configuration/enforcement drift is strongly supported. However, the data does not prove the 4,135-room decline was reaping or that ~10 MiB room files demonstrate compaction; those require operational logs or file-history evidence.
